description: Designs RPG progression and combat numbers in any engine: stats with a modifier stack, XP curves, damage formulas, items and equipment (slots, rarity, affixes) and quests. Use for a JRPG or Diablo-style looter, or stats wrong after unequipping. Pair with `save-systems` to save characters and inventory. Not for crafting and carry weight (`survival-crafting`) or dialogue (`dialogue-systems`).
